138: Good behaviour is the seed of good things. Bad behaviour always brings trouble.
140: People who have not learned to live in step with the world are still unlearned and foolish, no matter how much they have studied.
141: People in this world who truly understand goodness and wealth are never so foolish as to desire another man’s wife.
143: People who do wrong with the wife of someone who trusts them completely are surely no better than dead.
146: Enemies, sin, fear and shame: these four never leave a man who wrongs another man’s home.
153: The worst kind of being poor is turning away a guest. The greatest kind of strength is staying patient with foolish people.
168: Jealousy is a wicked thing like no other. It wipes out a person's riches and pushes them into a place of terrible suffering.
218: People who clearly understand their duty do not stop helping others, even when they themselves have very little.
223: Not saying the sad words “I have nothing,” and giving anyway, is found only in a person from a truly good family.
241: Kindness is the richest of all riches. Money and things can be found even in the hands of low, mean people.
245: Suffering never comes to people who live with kindness. This great, rich earth, where the wind blows, is the proof.
259: Not killing a single creature to eat it is better than making a thousand offerings by pouring ghee (melted butter) into a holy fire.
